【原视频简介】
ChatGPT Images 2.5 adds Sketch and new editing controls. See OpenAI’s editing examples, Charlie Guo’s butterfly stop motion, and a closer look at OpenAI’s internal model compared with Astra. I also use Astra Low to draw the DeepSeek logo and turn it into a whale stop motion.

This roundup also covers OpenAI’s separate internal-model research announcement, fresh Nex-N2.5-Max weight uploads, an unverified DeepSeek V4.1 Flash private-preview claim, and Adam Whitcroft’s Astra-assisted Tithe game.

CHAPTERS

ChatGPT Images 2.5 is here with new sketch-to-image capabilities and editing controls. See how these updates work in practice.

OpenAI has launched ChatGPT Images 2.5, featuring refined AI image editing and sketch-based generation. This video demonstrates these new tools in action, including Charlie Guo’s butterfly stop motion and Adam Whitcroft’s Astra-assisted game, Tithe. We also compare OpenAI’s internal model against Astra to see how the performance stacks up for creative workflows.

Beyond the image updates, we look at the latest AI model research from OpenAI and fresh weight uploads for Nex-N2.5-Max. There is also a breakdown of the unverified DeepSeek V4.1 private-preview claims circulating online. This update provides a clear look at where current generative models are heading and how to use these new features effectively.

Subscribe for weekly AI updates and practical breakdowns. Let me know in the comments if you want to see more testing on the new DeepSeek models.
